source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The inspected Thunderbird DNSOverHTTPS schema declares Enabled, ProviderURL, ExcludedDomains and Locked, but no Fallback. Its callback nevertheless checks Fallback === false inside the presence check for Enabled and assigns mode3 without a separate Enabled-true guard. These exact source windows establish a static callback/schema boundary. They do not establish whether the platform validator accepts, strips or rejects that property, or how a live DNS request behaves.
title: The DNS callback reads Fallback outside the inspected Thunderbird schema
